status: Phase C6 probes of the IMU-fused velocity and slope feedforward, Python implementation with the configured M10 sensor model; simulation under stated assumptions, not hardware-validated

scripts.jobrun.py: one moving_validate locomotion job: jobrun.py job sensors-override-json gains-override-json (TRACE=path.npy saves the trace)
scripts.case.py: one robustness case: SENS=sensors-override-json case.py case duration python gains-override-json
scripts.observer_probe.py: logs the slope observer against MuJoCo's true horizontal momentum (subtree_linvel) in one robustness case

results.sensors_hold: FAIL travel 0.151 m over 60 s, final velocity -0.0106 m/s (accelerometer/pitch bias becomes tau x bias velocity)
pass, travel 0.025 m, final velocity 0.026 m/s

diagnosis: delay_15ms_noise_x2_combined: with 15 ms transport plus 3 ms anti-alias lag, an ~11 Hz pitch oscillation (10 ms trace sampling) grows within 0.3 s while the legs extend from the crouch towards the tall posture (hip -151 to -144 deg), the tires lose contact and pitch passes 20 deg. Lower rate gains move the fall time non-monotonically, so no rate gain gives a robust margin; the case sets an absolute 15 ms delay, so an on-target latency requirement (option 2) does not change it either.

observer_revision.first_acceptance: Commit 435db6e observer (M v, requested wheel torque, no slew): targets met except all_27, but 60/70 survive (all ten push_low cases fall at 0.85 s), hold backlash pp 0.9-1.25 deg, inherited 23/27 (ideal_crouch, ideal_combined, sensors_push also fail). Not committed as the acceptance record.

fixes.change: observe CoM momentum M (v + dd/dt), d = CoM horizontal offset from the axle
fixes.why: pitching and leg motion move the CoM relative to the axle; read as an external force at the 65 deg posture
fixes.effect: ideal_crouch, ideal_combined, sensors_push pass; push_low falls later (4.1 s)

fixes.why: the 0.005 N m per wheel compensation is absorbed by hub friction; 0.28 N of phantom force, about 0.9 deg phantom slope
fixes.effect: hold limit cycle settles (backlash_hold_0.6 late pp 0.29 deg)

fixes.change: slew-limit the slope lean at slope_lean_rate_limit_rad_s = 0.1
fixes.why: a push is an impulsive external force; the observer jumps by impulse/tau and stepped the lean by up to 12 deg at the low posture (CoM 24.5 mm above the axle, lean per slope ~1.3)

observer_revision.residual: At standstill the tire's rolling friction holds a small static wheel torque that the observer reads as about 0.15 N; with the lean slew limit the result is a slow lean oscillation of 0.5-0.6 deg pp at hold and up to 1.8 deg late pp after low-posture pushes.
observer_revision.delay_15ms_noise_x2_drive: knife edge: passes with the first observer (MAE 0.0255) and with tau 0.5 s (0.0262), falls at 3.1-3.5 s with the adopted observer, with fusion only (observer off) and with lean slew 0.05; lean slew 0.2 falls at 10.3 s.
